title: Daily Standup: Cập nhật tiến độ rõ ràng
summary: Báo cáo outcome, priority và blocker có next action trong 60 giây.

sections.title: A concise update
sections.content: Yesterday: completed signup validation and tests. Today: deploy to staging and investigate payment timeout. Blocker: payment dashboard access; platform team has the request; fallback is pairing with Linh.

exercises.question: Which update names a blocker and next action?
options: Payment dashboard access is blocking comparison, so I asked Platform for permission.
correctAnswer: Payment dashboard access is blocking comparison, so I asked Platform for permission.
exercises.explanation: A useful blocker names what is missing, its effect and the action.

performanceTask.title: Deliver a concise Daily Standup
performanceTask.scenario: Bạn cập nhật cho một distributed engineering team.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Trong tối đa 60 giây, báo cáo yesterday, today và blocker mà chưa xem model/chunks.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Dùng facts chính: completed outcome, priority/expected result, blocker impact và next action.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Yesterday, I completed signup validation and added tests for the main error cases. Today, I will deploy the fix to staging and investigate a payment timeout. My current blocker is payment dashboard access, so I have asked the platform team for permission. If access is delayed, I will pair with Linh to continue.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Dùng search-index case mới; giữ update dưới 60 giây và sửa criterion cần tập trung.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Không xem model/chunks: cập nhật incident 503 với plan, estimate và collaborator.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Từ brief mới, deliver a concise standup with no blocker and one risk.

baseline.title: Payment timeout
baseline.brief: Update sau khi hoàn thành validation.

rubric.label: Yesterday–today–blocker
rubric.description: The listener can separate completed work, next priority and blocker status.

rubric.label: Technical specificity
rubric.description: Names a concrete feature, service, test, environment or metric.

rubric.label: Actionable blocker
rubric.description: States impact and next action, or clearly confirms no blocker.

audio.text: Yesterday, I completed the validation tests.
Today, I will reproduce the timeout.
My blocker is access to the payment dashboard.
If access is delayed, I will pair with Linh.

training.question: Which section is this?
training.feedback: Stress YESTERDAY and the completed result.

audio.text: Today, I will deploy and monitor error rates.

training.question: What is included?
training.feedback: Keep deploy and monitor as clear action verbs.

audio.text: I am blocked by missing vendor logs.

training.question: What is the blocker?
training.feedback: Make BLOCKED and VENDOR LOGS prominent.

audio.text: I asked SRE for the logs and will use staging data meanwhile.

training.question: What makes this actionable?
training.feedback: Link request and fallback in separate thought groups.

audio.text: I have no blockers at the moment.

training.question: What status is reported?
training.feedback: Say no blockers explicitly when true.

audio.text: My estimate is one day after the logs arrive.

training.question: What condition affects the estimate?
training.feedback: Keep the condition attached to the estimate.

audio.text: Yesterday, I finished the backfill script.
Today, I will verify two million documents.
Production snapshot approval is blocking verification.
Meanwhile, I will use an anonymized staging sample.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn YESTERDAY, TODAY, BLOCKER để người nghe định vị ba phần.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Thiếu signpost khiến update ngắn vẫn khó theo dõi.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Giữ âm cuối trong tests, logs, blockers; nhấn action verb và object.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Mất plural hoặc action làm scope/blocker không rõ.

modelAudio.text: Yesterday, I completed validation, which closed the main error cases.
Today, I will reproduce the timeout so that we can identify the failing dependency.

chunks.text: I am blocked by ___, which prevents ___.

modelAudio.text: I am blocked by dashboard access, which prevents provider comparison.

chunks.text: I have asked ___; meanwhile, I will ___.

modelAudio.text: I have asked Platform; meanwhile, I will inspect staging logs.

listenBackChecklist: Có technical detail nhưng không lan man.
Blocker đi với impact và next action.

interactionTurns.prompt: We are short on time—what is the single priority today?
interactionTurns.expectedFunction: state one priority and expected result briefly

interactionTurns.prompt: Who needs to act on the blocker, and what will you do meanwhile?
